EmailTemplate.subject: We missed you at our “Streamline your Outgoing Payments: Efficiency Gains for Canadian Higher Education” webinar!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
We missed you!
Our “Streamline your Outgoing Payments: Efficiency Gains for Canadian Higher Education <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/webinar-recording-streamline-your-outgoing-payments-efficiency-gains-for-canadian-higher-education]]>” webinar highlighted how Carleton University and Kwantlen Polytechnic University have taken steps to streamline processes to optimize their outgoing payments. By leveraging technology innovation to simplify international and domestic transfers, institutions are now able to increase payment speed, enhance security, and improve transparency to provide a better experience.
Here is the link to the webinar recording. <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/webinar-recording-streamline-your-outgoing-payments-efficiency-gains-for-canadian-higher-education]]>
Have questions? If you are a Flywire client, please reach out to your Relationship Manager. If not, just reply to this email and we’ll connect you with someone who can help.
Have a great day! Flywire Global Headquarters 141 Tremont Street, Boston, MA 02111 United States
